name: com.commencis.appconnect.sdk.notifications.NotificationTrampolineActivity
description: On Android 12 and later, Dataroid AppConnect uses this brief transparent screen when a push notification is tapped to record the tap, open its intended app action, and close.
disableEffect: The app remains usable, but on Android 12 and later AppConnect notification taps may no longer open the app or linked page or be recorded.
